wins.text: Shipped more than 15 million Windows AIPCs since December launch, multiples more than all competitors combined; on track to ship 40M+ AIPCs by year-end and 100M+ cumulatively by end of 2025
Intel Core Ultra volume more than doubled sequentially in Q2; Lunar Lake achieved production release ahead of schedule in July with 3x more NPU performance gen-on-gen
Q2 operating cash flow of $2.3B, up ~$3.5B sequentially on better working capital; adjusted free cash flow of $8.2B aided by Apollo SCIP investment of $11.5B in grants and partner contributions
Intel Products revenue of $11.8B, up 4% YoY; client business grew 9% YoY driven by AIPC ramp contributing to higher volume and ASPs
Mobileye revenue of $440M improved 84% sequentially as inventory digestion completed; Altera revenue up 6% sequentially with operating margins improving 4 points

risks.text: Q2 gross margin of 38.7% and EPS of $0.02 significantly below expectations; Q3 guided to ~38% gross margin and EPS of -$0.03 non-GAAP
Layoffs of greater than 15% of headcount by end of 2025; dividend suspended beginning Q4 2024 to preserve liquidity
Intel Foundry operating loss of $2.8B in Q2, expected to continue at approximately the same rate in Q3; more than 85% of wafer volumes still on pre-EUV nodes with uncompetitive cost structure

Weaker spending across consumer and enterprise markets, especially in China; export control restrictions negatively impacted client business in China; elevated customer inventory levels expected to weigh on H2 revenue

Lunar Lake uses largely external wafers with memory in-package sourced externally at 0% margin contribution, creating gross margin headwind through 2025; external wafer inflation adding further pressure

guidance_items.detail: Q3 revenue guided to $12.5B–$13.5B (midpoint $13B); below-seasonal growth cited due to elevated inventory, China weakness, and AI server spending crowding out traditional server demand
Q3 non-GAAP gross margin guided to ~38%, modestly weaker sequentially; 2025 gross margins expected up only modestly vs. 2024 due to Lunar Lake external wafer ramp
Q3 non-GAAP EPS guided to -$0.03; well below prior expectations driven by margin compression and restructuring charges
2024 gross CapEx reduced to $25B–$27B (>20% cut from plan); net CapEx $11B–$13B. 2025 gross CapEx targeted $20B–$23B, net $12B–$14B
2024 OpEx reduced to ~$20B; 2025 OpEx target of $17.5B, more than 20% below prior estimates; dividend suspended beginning Q4 2024

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Whether AMD is gaining structural market share in client and server vs. Intel's issues being purely macro/cyclical
Specific magnitude of the Oregon-to-Ireland fab transition headwind on gross margins and its duration
Progress and commitment level of external 18A foundry customers post-PDK release — whether pipeline is converting to committed programs
